subject: Error and solution in parameter definition table

messages.author: 723d1188ff9ab040
messages.subject: Error and solution in parameter definition table
parts:
Dear All,

I have created a parameter table that contained an error, namely that there was by mistake a comma left after the list of subbasins, I gave:

250,180,230,160,280,

The model did not give an error for this, but the run did not succeed.

Just to let you know about this problem.

All the best
Zsolt Jolankai
